```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
source(here::here("00_R", "simulate_shots_2.R"))
```

Quick test of the outputs of the second implementation of simulate_shots with various arguments.

```{r}
small_sim <- simulate_shots(n_observations = 100, n_defenders = 20)

small_sim_stand <- simulate_shots(n_observations = 100, n_defenders = 20, foul_count_transform = "standardized")

small_sim_fac <- simulate_shots(n_observations = 100, n_defenders = 20, foul_count_transform = "ordered")
```

```{r}
small_sim |> glimpse()
```

```{r}
small_sim_stand |> glimpse()
```

```{r}
small_sim_fac |> glimpse()
```
